name: Sződ (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sződ: a red and blue shield with ears of grain, a bunch of grapes and a ploughshare, within a wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and blue triangles
